text:
maya: Heads up — starting a short planning thread for a "landing zone" playbook for model entry + safe rollback. Goal: an MVP playbook for Q2 that covers onboarding checklist, benchmark gates, pinning and exception flow, deprecation runway, canary cadence, and rollback triggers. Thoughts?

aaron: +1. we should reuse any gates we already have for falconx but keep the initial scope small.

jules: Proposed minimal gates: perf, quality, infra/cost. Perf = p95 latency target by family, Quality = eval delta vs baseline (A/B or prompt set), Infra = unit-cost / autoscale sanity. Also call out data/security controls for private customers.

samir: Pinning principle: default = floating unless explicitly requested. If pinned, TTL = 90d and require a migration plan. Pin-exception form for enterprise exceptions.

maya: sounds good. we need concrete thresholds for the gates to be actionable. Suggest: p95 <= 120ms for short-context hosted models; p95 <= 300ms for long-context; cache hit >= 30%; unit-cost delta <= 20% vs previous model.

liz: Canary rollout cadence proposal: 10% traffic for 24h, 50% for 48h, full for 7d. Define metric windows (5m for infra, 1h for quality checks) and kill-switch criteria.

oncall-bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-05-10 22:00 UTC — DO NOT MERGE until canary config present.

aaron: Customer comms: include an opt-out migration window and a reusable email/template we can send for pinned customers. Should also auto-generate a migration checklist for large customers.

maya: Can someone paste a short rollback/run command we can embed in the playbook? e.g., a minimal runbook snippet.

jules: Rollback triggers sketch: >10% increase in error rate, >15% quality regression on canary prompt set, >2x unit-cost sustained, sustained p95 >2x baseline for 10m. If any trigger fires, immediate rollback to last stable version and page SRE.

samir: We'll add an automatic fallback flag for critical routes so traffic falls back to last-stable model variant instead of failing. That helps prod continuity while ops triages.

liz: Also include "gracepath" for pinned customers: 30-day notice before deprecation + migration assistance (migration sprints, extra credits).

maya: Action items: maya -> draft playbook doc; jules -> write up gate metrics + thresholds; samir -> pin/exception flow + private-deploy differences; aaron -> comms template + opt-out flow; liz -> rollout cadence and kill-switch details. Target: first draft EOD next Wed.

aaron: Also include a tiny bench harness example for onboarding so teams can run the eval quickly.

jules: here's a minimal harness snippet for docs:```python
# runbench.py
from redwood import CatalogClient
client = CatalogClient()
res = client.benchmark(model='MODEL_ID', dataset='onboard_sample', metrics=['p95','tokens','accuracy'])
print(res)
```

samir: NOTE: Private deployments need a separate pin TTL policy — legal/customer agreement required. Set TTL = indefinite for signed contracts unless they opt into migration windows.

jules: we should surface a computed "migration-risk" tag in the catalog UI (low/med/high) based on eval gap, infra delta, and downstream dependencies. Helps prioritization.

maya: ok great — i'll draft and link a confluence page here once it's up. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan or reply if you want to change scope.
